ip_eth_rx_64.summary: IP receive parser for 64-bit Ethernet frames: a 5-state FSM captures IP header words into field registers, verifies version/IHL and checksum, then realigns payload by 32 bits into a skid-buffered output stream.

blocks.name: Receive FSM
blocks.description: Sequences header capture, payload transfer and frame drop with header handshakes.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, read header, read payload, payload last, wait last (drop).

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid; starts frame reception in idle.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Ethernet header ready, asserted in idle when output header free.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP header valid, raised after good checksum.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream accepts IP header, clearing header valid.

anchors.name: store_eth_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable for Ethernet MAC/type registers.

anchors.name: store_hdr_word_0
anchors.why: Loads first header word fields (version, IHL, length, flags).

anchors.name: store_hdr_word_1
anchors.why: Loads TTL, protocol, checksum, source IP.

anchors.name: store_hdr_word_2
anchors.why: Loads destination IP.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Saves last payload word for READ_PAYLOAD_LAST.

anchors.name: flush_save
anchors.why: Clears saved beat state at frame end.

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Load enable for saved payload beat.

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte pointer selecting which header word to store.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes from IP length; trims tkeep and detects early end.

blocks.name: IP header field registers
blocks.description: Parsed Ethernet and IP header fields driven in parallel to outputs.

anchors.name: m_ip_length_reg
anchors.why: Captured IP length; initializes payload word count.

anchors.name: m_ip_version_reg
anchors.why: Captured IP version checked for validity.

anchors.name: m_ip_dest_ip
anchors.why: Decoded destination IP output field.

anchors.name: m_ip_source_ip
anchors.why: Decoded source IP output field.

anchors.name: s_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Ethernet header field latched with MAC/type registers.

blocks.name: Header checksum
blocks.description: Accumulates 16-bit header sums and checks the folded checksum.

anchors.name: hdr_sum_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated IP header checksum sum.

anchors.name: hdr_sum_low_reg
anchors.why: Partial 16-bit sum of low half of beat for checksum.

anchors.name: hdr_sum_temp
anchors.why: Folded final checksum compared against all-ones.

anchors.name: check_hdr_reg
anchors.why: Pending checksum check next cycle; gates header valid or drop.

blocks.name: Payload realignment
blocks.description: Shifts payload by 32 bits using saved beat and extra flush cycle.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Ethernet payload data: parsed into IP header fields and shifted payload.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload beat valid; advances header pointer and checksum partial sums.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from FSM and output backpressure.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Frame end; sets saved tlast and extra shift cycle.

anchors.name: save_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Previous payload beat saved for 32-bit realignment.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Realigned payload combining saved and current beats.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Valid of realigned payload beat.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Realigned last flag; terminates header/payload states.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_s_tready
anchors.why: Shifter input ready, low during extra flush cycle.

anchors.name: shift_eth_payload_extra_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Extra output cycle needed for leftover upper bytes.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload word while consuming trailing frame bytes.

blocks.name: Output skid buffer
blocks.description: Two-register skid buffer driving the IP payload stream.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: IP payload output data from skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: IP payload output valid.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready; drives skid buffer and early ready.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Payload end-of-frame output.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid_int
anchors.why: Internal payload valid into skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating payload transfer.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early ready when output ready or both buffers empty.

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register when output stalled.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal payload into output register.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Loads internal payload into temp register.

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Moves temp register to output register.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Frame ended inside IP header.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Frame ended before IP length satisfied.

anchors.name: error_invalid_header
anchors.why: Version/IHL check failed.

anchors.name: error_invalid_checksum
anchors.why: IP header checksum mismatch.

ip_eth_tx_64.summary: IP-to-Ethernet transmitter (64-bit): an FSM latches IP header fields, computes the header checksum, emits header words then payload realigned by a 32-bit shift register, through a skid-buffered AXI-stream output.

blocks.name: Frame FSM
blocks.description: Sequences header words, payload transfer, trimming and discard.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Frame FSM: idle, header words, payload, last word, wait-last discard.

anchors.name: store_ip_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all IP and Ethernet header fields.

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Enable latching last_word_data_reg and keep.

anchors.name: transfer_in_save
anchors.why: Enable capturing input word into save registers.

anchors.name: flush_save
anchors.why: Clears save tlast and extra-cycle flags at frame boundaries.

blocks.name: Header registers and checksum
blocks.description: Latched IP/Ethernet header fields and checksum accumulator.

anchors.name: ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched header field emitted in header word.

anchors.name: ip_length_reg
anchors.why: Latched IP length, initializes word_count.

anchors.name: hdr_sum_reg
anchors.why: Accumulated header checksum sum, folded and inverted into header word.

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte pointer selecting which header word to emit.

blocks.name: Payload length tracking
blocks.description: Byte counter against IP length for tkeep trimming and errors.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes; trims tkeep and detects early termination.

blocks.name: Payload realignment
blocks.description: 32-bit shift of payload behind header and last-word holding.

anchors.name: save_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Saved previous payload word, upper half shifted into output for realignment.

anchors.name: shift_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Realigned payload word combining saved and current input halves.

anchors.name: shift_ip_payload_extra_cycle_reg
anchors.why: Extra output cycle needed to flush trailing half word.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final trimmed word while discarding excess input.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Internal output word muxed from header fields, shifted payload or last word.

blocks.name: Output skid buffer
blocks.description: Two-register AXI-stream output buffer with registered ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output Ethernet payload: IP header words followed by payload.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Output ready; drives skid buffer and tready_int_early.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready from skid buffer gating FSM output transfers.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp data when output stalls.

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable for output registers from internal path.

blocks.name: Input interfaces
blocks.description: IP header and payload input handshakes plus Ethernet header output.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP header valid; accepted in idle to start a frame.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: IP header ready, registered from FSM.

anchors.name: s_ip_length
anchors.why: IP length field; latched and used to compute payload word_count and checksum.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload data, shifted by 32 bits after the header.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid, feeds shift_ip_payload_axis_tvalid.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready, registered from FSM and output readiness.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Payload end marker; sets save tlast and extra shift cycle.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid, set when IP header accepted.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Ethernet header ready clears m_eth_hdr_valid_next.

blocks.name: Status
blocks.description: Busy and early termination error outputs.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy status while FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error strobe when payload ends before IP length.

ip_64.summary: IPv4 layer wrapper: an RX parser and TX framer child handle Ethernet/IP conversion, while a 3-state FSM resolves the destination MAC via ARP before forwarding or dropping each outgoing packet.

blocks.name: ARP resolution controller
blocks.description: FSM requesting ARP lookup, latching resolved MAC, then forwarding or dropping the outgoing packet.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/ARP_QUERY/WAIT_PACKET controller sequencing ARP lookup and outgoing packet transfer.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing IP header request; starts ARP query from IDLE.

anchors.name: arp_request_valid
anchors.why: ARP lookup request for destination IP, raised from IDLE.

anchors.name: arp_response_valid
anchors.why: ARP response arrival; moves FSM to WAIT_PACKET.

anchors.name: arp_response_mac
anchors.why: Resolved destination MAC latched into outgoing_eth_dest_mac.

anchors.name: drop_packet_reg
anchors.why: Set on ARP error; sinks outgoing payload by forcing tready.

anchors.name: outgoing_ip_hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Header valid into TX framer after successful ARP resolution.

anchors.name: outgoing_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Holds ARP-resolved destination MAC for the packet being transmitted.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Outgoing payload ready: TX child ready or forced by drop_packet; ends WAIT_PACKET.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Accepts outgoing IP header once ARP response received.

anchors.name: arp_response_ready
anchors.why: Ready for ARP response, asserted during ARP query.

anchors.name: arp_request_ip
anchors.why: IP address looked up by ARP, copy of s_ip_dest_ip.

anchors.name: tx_error_arp_failed
anchors.why: Reports ARP lookup failure causing packet drop.

blocks.name: IP receive path
blocks.description: ip_eth_rx_64 child parsing Ethernet frames into IP header fields and payload.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received Ethernet payload stream fed to the IP RX parser.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Received Ethernet header valid into RX parser.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Parsed IP payload output stream from the RX parser.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Parsed IP header valid output from RX parser.

anchors.name: rx_busy
anchors.why: RX parser busy indication.

blocks.name: IP transmit path
blocks.description: ip_eth_tx_64 child building Ethernet frames from IP header and payload.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmitted Ethernet frame payload from the TX framer.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing Ethernet header valid from TX framer.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Outgoing IP payload data passed to TX framer.

anchors.name: tx_busy
anchors.why: TX framer busy indication.

anchors.name: local_mac
anchors.why: Local MAC configuration used as source MAC of transmitted frames.
